# Bagula II Gram Panchayat

> Official public service facilitation portal of Bagula II Gram Panchayat, Hanskhali Block, Nadia District, West Bengal. Provides information and redirection to government services for birth/death registration, WBPMS certificates, MGNREGA, PRD tax, and local certificate issuance.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Portal overview with search, service directory, and latest updates.
- [Dependent Certificate](/dependent-certificate): Staff dependent certificate issuance workflow.
- [Warish Certificate](/warish-certificate): Warish (succession) (warish) certificate issuance workflow.
- [WBPMS Certificate Services](/wbpms-info): Document requirements and links for residential, income, caste, character and other certificates via WBPMS portal.
- [Elected Representatives](/elected-representatives): Prodhan, Upa-Prodhan and ward members of Bagula II Gram Panchayat.
